page_title: GIR 3-3 OVI | Girona v Oviedo 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Ruiz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+7' 3 - 3 Goal! David Carmo (R. Oviedo) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 3:3.
90+7' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. R. Oviedo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+6' Paulo Gazzaniga reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) towards the roof of the net. The ball goes out for a corner. R. Oviedo can continue in their attacking effort.
90+3' Arnau Martinez (Girona) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 3 - 2 Goal! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Aaron Escandell to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
90' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is going to take the penalty!
89' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul after Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) hacks down one of his opponents. That is a penalty kick for Girona.
86' Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.

83' 2 - 2 Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) receives a sweet pass, finds some free space and scores from the edge of the box. His shot goes in off the right post and ends in the back of the net. No criticism here. That was nice piece of skill.
81' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
80' A corner kick by Girona is thwarted by the well prepared Aaron Escandell (R. Oviedo).
80' Girona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

79' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Aaron Escandell stops the ball out of the bottom right corner. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) replaces Ilyas Chaira.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo) will replace Javi Lopez.
73' Michel prepares a substitution. Joel Roca is replaced by Portu (Girona).
70' The foul by Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alejandro Ruiz.
70' The ratio of the ball possession is 67:33.
68' Here comes a substitution. Thomas Lemar (Girona) is brought on as a substitute for Bryan Gil.
66' The main referee, Alejandro Ruiz, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Bryan Gil (Girona) is given a yellow card for dissent.
65' Luis Carrion decides to make a substitution. Leander Dendoncker will be replaced by Kwasi Sibo (R. Oviedo).
65' Substitution. Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) replaces Federico Vinas.
64' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Cristhian Stuani (Girona) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Aaron Escandell no chance!
64' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
63' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
63' Referee Alejandro Ruiz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
63' PENALTY APPEAL by Girona, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
61' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) comes close to scoring with a glancing header towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him by making a save.
59' Michel has decided to substitute Daley Blind and he is replaced by Hugo Rincon (Girona).
59' Substitution. Vladyslav Vanat will be replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Viktor Tsygankov trots off the pitch and is replaced by Azzedine Ounahi (Girona).
57' 0 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 0:2.
57' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to R. Oviedo.
56' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
52' The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
49' The substitution is prepared. Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oviemuno Ejaria.
48' The game is interrupted now, Oviemuno Ejaria (R. Oviedo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' Oviemuno Ejaria (R. Oviedo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
47' A cross into the box from Bryan Gil (Girona) is cleared.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Alejandro Ruiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
45+2' The referee signals a corner kick to Girona.
45+2' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Moreno (Girona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Good work from Girona as they win a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
44' Vitor Reis (Girona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
43' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alex Moreno (Girona) but poses no threat.
43' Joel Roca (Girona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
41' Joel Roca (Girona) works the corner short.
41' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
38' 0 - 1 Goal! Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Paulo Gazzaniga into the top right corner.
38' Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
36' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
36' Referee Alejandro Ruiz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for R. Oviedo. Let’s see what happens!
35' Surely that's handball by one of the Girona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
34' Paulo Gazzaniga makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) after a cross from the side.

34' The ball goes out of play and R. Oviedo will have a goal kick. What a poor attempt! Axel Witsel (Girona) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
33' Shots on target – 1:1.
33' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
31' Daley Blind (Girona) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Joel Roca, but Aaron Escandell displays great awareness to stop him.
30' Paulo Gazzaniga displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
29' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
29' Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
28' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
25' Bryan Gil (Girona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
24' Joel Roca (Girona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
24' Alex Moreno (Girona) sprays a pass out to Joel Roca, but he can't beat his man inside the box.

22' Girona players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for R. Oviedo.
21' Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a throw-in.
19' Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
19' R. Oviedo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Javi Lopez (R. Oviedo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
15' Girona are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
14' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Oviemuno Ejaria (R. Oviedo).

13' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.

11' Joel Roca (Girona) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Aaron Escandell. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
9' David Carmo (R. Oviedo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
8' R. Oviedo keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
6' Oviemuno Ejaria (R. Oviedo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and R. Oviedo will take a throw-in.
5' Dangerous play by Axel Witsel (Girona). Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. R. Oviedo win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
4' Ivan Martin received a clever long ball from Daley Blind (Girona) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
3' Joel Roca (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' A player from R. Oviedo commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' The first half has started.
R. Oviedo will kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
